ld.description:
Live aerialists, immersive visuals, and a champagne toast and balloon drop at midnight!  
  
Gravagerz is an Italian DJ, record producer, and songwriter based in Luxembourg. Known for his signature Euphoric House sound, he blends elements of House, UK Garage, and Dubstep into his productions. As an independent artist, Gravagerz has accumulated over 7 million monthly Spotify listeners and more than 300 million combined streams across various platforms. In addition to his solo work, he is a versatile producer, collaborating with hip-hop, pop, K-pop, R&B, and dance artists on their upcoming albums.

In 2020, Gravagerz signed a management contract with Leaf Music Management at the age of 17. His early releases included "Look Back at It" with Tom Field on B1 Recordings, as well as remixes for Regard x Ella Henderson and Era Istrefi. His breakthrough came with "Chihiro", originally a remix of Billie Eilish's song on SoundCloud, which went viral on TikTok and Instagram, amassing over 200 million combined streams and 1.2 million video creators using the track. After replacing the vocals, he officially released it as his own version.  
  
Following this success, he secured an official remix of Quavo and Lana Del Rey’s “Tough” followed by another official cover release of Disclosure and London Grammar’s “Help Me Lose My Mind”, which garnered over 50 million streams and 50,000 video creators on social media.

In April 2025, Gravagerz released “Pool” featuring Kiki Wera, marking his first record to chart in the UK Top 100, reaching 15 million combined streams and inspiring 20,000 video creators.

His remixes frequently go viral on TikTok, with multiple tracks exceeding 50,000 video creators, including Drake’s “Time Flies,” A$AP Rocky’s “Fukk Sleep,” and WizzTheMC’s “Show Me Love."

Rising DJ and producer, Capochino has been brewing a genre-bending sound that has been tipping hats from industry veterans and landing him on the map as an artist to watch out for. From electrifying performances at iconic venues like The Marc, Kingdom Nightclub, Vulcan Gas Company, and The Venue, to sharing stages with respected artists such as Alleycvt, Hairitage, Saymyname, Kompany, Hermitude and Dirty Snatcha, Capochino’s ascent has been nothing short of meteoric. With the backing of influential figures like Mersiv, Levity, Dr. Fresch, and Zingara, multiple tracks getting played at EDC Las Vegas and Electric Forest, and making his festival debut at Home Bass in Florida, 2024 has proven to be a whirlwind year for this sonic storyteller.

Raised in Monterrey, Mexico and currently based in Austin, Texas, Capochino’s unique soundscapes draw influence from the two cities he calls home. From brooding mid-tempo tracks to bass-heavy anthems, Capochino fearlessly explores a spectrum of sounds and styles. He made a profound impact with his first track of the year, “Woke Symphony,” premiering on Headbang Society, followed by “Untethered Soul” featuring jean, released on Excision’s Subsidia Records. With each release, Capochino doesn’t just deliver music; he invites listeners to embrace their roots and tell their own stories through their unique creative expressions.

On December 12th, MVSON lands at 99 Scott for a New York takeover bringing the Manchester born event brand and record label to Brooklyn.

MVSON events have become known for carefully selected lineups, packed rooms and crowds that reflect the open spirit at the center of the brand. Rather than operating as a standard artist led party series, MVSON has developed into a platform of its own, bringing together names from across house and club music while creating space for artists connected to its wider circle.

Alongside the events, MVSON has expanded into a record label, giving the platform another way to introduce music beyond the dance floor. The label serves as a home for releases tied to the sound and culture surrounding the parties.

Now MVSON heads to New York, with 99 Scott becoming the next setting for the UK born brand as its event series and label arrive in Brooklyn for one night.

Built from Manchester club culture and carried outward through its events and releases, MVSON has become a meeting point for artists, records and crowds around it. December 12th marks the next step for the platform as it brings that energy into a well known Brooklyn room.

ld.description:
Brutalismus 3000 headlines a special edition of RUSH alongside SPFDJ, Dorian Electra, Eera, and Nurse (Body Bag) on Nov 6.

The German duo has exploded onto the global stage with a singularly unhinged take on the rave-techno-hardcore continuum. Fusing gabber and schranz with hyperpop-worthy hooks and a sense of punk populism inherited from artists like The Prodigy, Brutalismus 3000 land like a sledgehammer against the stifling forces of conformity.

SPFDJ makes her long-awaited RUSH debut. The Herrensauna resident and Intrepid Skin label boss is one of the most notorious DJs working today. Her singular mix of raw, thundering techno, tweaked, wired club sounds, fearless rave moments and cheeky vocal flips has made her a figurehead for a generation of artists who dare to reimagine clubbing through a defiant, punk lens. Surf Gang's Eera is one of the driving forces behind the modern wave of hyper-blended electronic music, where trance, hardcore, emo and much more swirl together in a vivid tapestry.

Neo-pop diva Dorian Electra joins with a special DJ set. They arrive fresh off the release of their new self-titled LP, a run of covers that reimagines ten classic songs through a manic, high-speed filter. Finally, Body Bag affiliate Nurse ramps up the BPM to dangerous levels. The Body Bag tagline promises "grotesque hardcore" - Nurse delivers.
